longTitle.officialTitle: To extend reemployment services and eligibility assessments to all claimants for unemployment benefits, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Building on Reemployment Improvements to Deliver Good Employment for Workers Act” or the “BRIDGE for Workers Act”.

subsection.heading: In General.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 306(a) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 506(a)) is amended—

paragraph.content: by striking “individuals referred to reemployment services as described in section 303(j)” and inserting “claimants for regular compensation, including claimants referred to reemployment services as described in section 303(j),”; and
by striking “such individuals” and inserting “such claimants”.

subsection.heading: Effective Date.—
subsection.content: The amendments made by subsection (a) shall take effect on the date of enactment of this Act.
